title: Are the Rams cooked? A look at why Sean McVay's team is so disappointing, and if they can bounce back

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Are the Rams cooked? A look at why Sean McVay's team is so disappointing, and if they can bounce back
sources.description: A disastrous special teams unit, Matthew Stafford's missing deep ball and a flurry of key injuries have sent the preseason Super Bowl favorites spiraling to a 2-4 start
